note: Decisions of the cast sweep (2026-10-30) applied to staging/cast-sweep/people.json by finalize.py. Names are the canonical names of the person check.

excludeReal.reason: A real person's cameo in the game (a developer or composer). No persona is written for a real person.

excludePlaceholder.reason: A test or system label, not a character (placeholder name, news ticker, shop label, corporate system).

excludeAddon.reason: Has its own add-on (Delamain, Skippy): the add-on owns the character, the main mod does not.

mergeInto.reason: The same person as a character who is already on the roster or has a fuller entry: the records join that entry (roster rows keep their own records here only when listed in mergeRosterRecords).

dropAsRosterDuplicate.reason: A short display name of a character who is already on the roster (Evelyn Parker, Solomon Reed, Muamar Reyes).

ambiguousSingleNames.reason: A single first name that several different people carry in the game (or that is also the first name of another profile). The profile lookup matches a display name exactly, so one such profile would answer for all of them. They keep the archetype talk of their role.
